The SNS (Skew-Normal Splatting) method was introduced to address the limitations of standard 3D Gaussian Splatting in modeling asymmetric shapes.
Standard 3DGS uses symmetric 2D Gaussians, which cannot capture skewness.
The SNS method introduces a 2D Skew-Normal distribution.
